entry.content:
flutter: learn a word from search, line translation, i18n parity; CI test gate; nightly DB backup

mobile
- tapping a search result now creates a Word of the Day from that song (POST /daily-word/from-track)
  like the web app, instead of bouncing out to Spotify; Spotify stays as a trailing icon
- card back shows the lyric line translation when the payload has one
- Discover/Settings/nav/flip hints translated via context.tr with {var} interpolation + plurals;
  i18n parity test added
- welcome copy no longer promises karaoke; lint clean (unused imports, deprecated value:, doc comment)

ci
- deploy now waits for server mocha, web node tests and flutter analyze/test; runs on PRs too
- concurrency no longer cancels an in-flight deploy (Traefik cutover must not be interrupted)

ops
- scripts/backup-sqlite.sh: online better-sqlite3 backup inside the api container, integrity check,
  gzip, 14-day retention; systemd service + 03:30 UTC timer under scripts/systemd

entry.title: server: harden API and stop provider storms
entry.content:
server: harden API and stop provider storms

- CORS allowlist (same-origin, dev hosts, CORS_ORIGINS) instead of reflecting any Origin with credentials
- security headers (nosniff, frame, referrer, permissions, HSTS over https); x-powered-by off; 256kb JSON limit
- rate limits on login/register/refresh, public Deezer/LRCLib proxies and pronounce
- register validation (email format, 8-char min) and case-insensitive email uniqueness
- OpenRouter circuit breaker: skip for 2 min after a 429 instead of 200+ retries; fast path fails instantly when both providers cool down
- TTS: Pocket-TTS first when the host daemon serves the language; Kokoro remembers a missing Python runtime
- daily word: try 3 preview-window picks before accepting an out-of-preview word; extras prefer preview lines
- tests: await async playlist handlers, gate Kokoro integration test behind KOKORO_INTEGRATION=1

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
